"""Loaded-native source admission only: exact32-step imagination, no optimizer."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,types
import torch

def check(mdp,wm,pi,critic,bank_state,learner_source):
    """Caller already loaded qualified134 and sharednormal86 once each."""
    assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized(), 'CPU source admission only'
    source=Path(learner_source).read_bytes();tree=ast.parse(source)
    cls=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='SuperMimicLearner')
    method=next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='_imag_step')
    lines=source.decode('utf8').splitlines(True);original=''.join(lines[method.lineno-1:method.end_lineno])
    method.name='_exact_native_imag_step'
    module=ast.Module(body=[method],type_ignores=[]);ast.fix_missing_locations(module)
    namespace={'torch':torch,'State':tuple};exec(compile(module,str(learner_source),'exec'),namespace)
    step=namespace['_exact_native_imag_step']
    names=('wm','pi','critic');modules=(wm,pi,critic)
    buffers={name:{k:v.detach().clone() for k,v in m.named_buffers()} for name,m in zip(names,modules)}
    flags=[[(p,p.requires_grad) for p in m.parameters()] for m in modules]
    for p in wm.parameters():p.requires_grad_(False)
    for p in critic.parameters():p.requires_grad_(False)
    for p in pi.parameters():p.requires_grad_(True)
    rng=torch.random.get_rng_state().clone()
    try:
        torch.manual_seed(165)
        ids=torch.tensor([0,16,23,132],device=bank_state[0].device)
        state=tuple(x[ids].detach().clone() for x in bank_state)
        events=mdp.provider.metadata['events_public_age']
        ages=[200,max(200,int(events['push_end'])-16),int((events['push_end']+events['touchdown'])//2),int(events['touchdown'])]
        from private_phase_frame_v1 import encode,decode
        frames=encode(torch.tensor(ages,device=ids.device),torch.zeros(4,device=ids.device,dtype=torch.long))
        context=state[0].new_zeros(4,31)
        previous=state[0].new_zeros(4,6)
        obs=mdp.obs(state,previous,context,frames)
        hist=obs[:,None,:].expand(-1,10,-1).clone();goal=mdp.goal(frames,10)
        normalized=mdp.normalize_context(context)
        instance=types.SimpleNamespace(pi=pi,wm=wm,mdp=mdp,cfg=types.SimpleNamespace(goal_frames=10))
        rewards=[];dones=[];actions=[];previous_actions=[];goals=[]
        with torch.inference_mode(False),torch.enable_grad():
            for _ in range(32):
                before=previous
                state,previous,hist,frames,goal=step(instance,state,hist,previous,frames,context,normalized,goal)
                assert all(torch.isfinite(x).all() for x in state) and torch.isfinite(previous).all()
                rewards.append(mdp.reward(state,frames,previous,before))
                dones.append(mdp.soft_termination(state,frames))
                actions.append(previous);previous_actions.append(before);goals.append(goal)
            reward=torch.stack(rewards);done=torch.stack(dones)
            assert torch.isfinite(reward).all() and torch.isfinite(done).all()
            alive=torch.cumprod(1-done,0);continuation=torch.cat((torch.ones_like(alive[:1]),alive[:-1]),0)
            discount=.99**torch.arange(32,device=reward.device,dtype=reward.dtype)[:,None]
            tracking_return=(discount*continuation*reward).sum(0)
            critic_input=torch.cat((mdp.critic_features(state,frames,normalized),goal),-1)
            value=critic(critic_input)
            complete_return=tracking_return+.99**32*alive[-1]*value
            params=tuple(pi.parameters())
            grad_tracking=torch.autograd.grad(-tracking_return.mean(),params,allow_unused=True,retain_graph=True)
            grad_total=torch.autograd.grad(-complete_return.mean(),params,allow_unused=True)
            def summary(grads):
                valid=[g.detach() for g in grads if g is not None]
                assert valid and all(torch.isfinite(g).all() for g in valid)
                return {'L2':float(torch.sqrt(sum((g*g).sum() for g in valid))), 'nonzero_tensors':sum(bool((g!=0).any()) for g in valid),'tensors':len(valid)}

function p=buildProfile(X,act,E)
dt=.01;mid=(E.push_end+E.touchdown)/2;before=floor(mid);duration=(E.touchdown-E.push_end)*dt;
p=struct('t_coast',E.coast_end*dt,'t_crouch_end',E.crouch_end*dt,'t_push_end',E.push_end*dt, ...
 't_middle',mid*dt,'t_touch',E.touchdown*dt,'q_start',X(E.coast_end+1,13+act).', ...
 'q_crouch',X(E.crouch_end+1,13+act).','q_extend',X(E.push_end+1,13+act).','q_land',X(E.touchdown+1,13+act).');
assert(duration>0&&p.t_crouch_end>p.t_coast&&p.t_push_end>p.t_crouch_end);
if mid==fix(mid),p.q_tuck=X(mid+1,13+act).';p.tuck_source='Exactparenthalf-flightknot';
else
 u=2*(before-E.push_end)/(E.touchdown-E.push_end);[s,~,~]=quintic(u);assert(s>.5);
 p.q_tuck=(X(before+1,13+act).'-(1-s)*p.q_extend)/s;p.tuck_source='Recoveredknownquinticendpoint, entireairmotorpathverified';
end
end
function [q,qd,qdd]=legProfile(t,p)
if t<=p.t_crouch_end,[q,qd,qdd]=segment(t,p.t_coast,p.t_crouch_end,p.q_start,p.q_crouch);
elseif t<=p.t_push_end,[q,qd,qdd]=segment(t,p.t_crouch_end,p.t_push_end,p.q_crouch,p.q_extend);
elseif t<=p.t_middle,[q,qd,qdd]=segment(t,p.t_push_end,p.t_middle,p.q_extend,p.q_tuck);
else,[q,qd,qdd]=segment(t,p.t_middle,p.t_touch,p.q_tuck,p.q_land);end
end
function [q,qd,qdd]=segment(t,a,b,q0,q1)
T=b-a;[s,ds,dds]=quintic((t-a)/T);delta=q1-q0;q=q0+s*delta;qd=ds*delta/T;qdd=dds*delta/T^2;
end
function [s,ds,dds]=quintic(u)
if u<0,s=0;ds=0;dds=0;elseif u>1,s=1;ds=0;dds=0;
else,s=10*u^3-15*u^4+6*u^5;ds=30*u^2-60*u^3+30*u^4;dds=60*u-180*u^2+120*u^3;end
end

function H=centroidalH(C,G,d)

for b=1:31

end

end

function [I,h]=bodyCentroidalModel(C,G,d)
names=cellstr(string(G.body_names));I=zeros(3);h=zeros(3,1);VC=zeros(3,31);PC=VC;Ib=zeros(3,3,31);moment=zeros(3,1);
for b=1:31
 row=C.bodies.(names{b});A=d.body_rotation(:,:,b);r=A*row.com_m(:);PC(:,b)=d.body_position(:,b)+r;
 VC(:,b)=d.body_velocity(:,b)+cross(d.body_angular_velocity(:,b),r);moment=moment+row.mass_kg*VC(:,b);
 P=quatMatrix(row.principal_axes_wxyz);Ib(:,:,b)=A*P*diag(row.diagonal_inertia_kg_m2)*P.'*A.';
end
vCOM=moment/d.total_mass_kg;
for b=1:31
 m=C.bodies.(names{b}).mass_kg;r=PC(:,b)-d.COM;
 I=I+Ib(:,:,b)+m*((r.'*r)*eye(3)-r*r.');
 h=h+Ib(:,:,b)*d.body_angular_velocity(:,b)+m*cross(r,VC(:,b)-vCOM);
end
I=(I+I.')/2;
end

function H=centroidalH(C,G,d)
[~,H]=bodyCentroidalModel(C,G,d);
end

function value=shootObjective(H,I,h,q0,Rtarget,dt,substeps,Hguess)
[~,R]=integrateAttitude(I,h,q0,H,dt,substeps);e=rotationLog(R(:,:,end)*Rtarget.');
value=e.'*e+1e-10*sum((H-Hguess).^2);
end

function [Q,R,omega,maxNorm]=integrateAttitude(I,h,q0,H,dt,substeps)
N=size(h,1);Q=zeros(N,4);R=zeros(3,3,N);omega=zeros(N,3);q=q0(:)/norm(q0);Q(1,:)=q.';maxNorm=0;
for k=1:N-1
 for s=1:substeps
  a=(s-1)/substeps;da=1/substeps;ds=dt/substeps;
  f1=attitudeRHS(q,a,I(:,:,k),I(:,:,k+1),h(k,:).',h(k+1,:).',H);
  f2=attitudeRHS(q+ds*f1/2,a+da/2,I(:,:,k),I(:,:,k+1),h(k,:).',h(k+1,:).',H);
  f3=attitudeRHS(q+ds*f2/2,a+da/2,I(:,:,k),I(:,:,k+1),h(k,:).',h(k+1,:).',H);
  f4=attitudeRHS(q+ds*f3,a+da,I(:,:,k),I(:,:,k+1),h(k,:).',h(k+1,:).',H);
  next=q+ds*(f1+2*f2+2*f3+f4)/6;maxNorm=max(maxNorm,abs(norm(next)-1));q=next/norm(next);
 end
 Q(k+1,:)=q.';
end
for k=1:N
 R(:,:,k)=quatMatrix(Q(k,:));body=I(:,:,k)\(R(:,:,k).'*H-h(k,:).');omega(k,:)=(R(:,:,k)*body).';
end
end

function derivative=attitudeRHS(q,a,I0,I1,h0,h1,H)
I=(1-a)*I0+a*I1;h=(1-a)*h0+a*h1;R=quatMatrix(q);w=I\(R.'*H-h);
derivative=.5*[-dot(q(2:4),w);q(1)*w+cross(q(2:4),w)];
end

function result=conditionalInverseDynamics(C,names,act,d,loopRows,acceleration,s)
J=d.loop_J(loopRows,:);E=[d.B_action_torque_order6,J.'];b=d.M*acceleration+d.h-d.gas_generalized_force;
least=pinv(E)*b;peak=[C.leg_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(4,1);C.wheel_motor.peak_torque_nm*ones(2,1)];
stall=[C.leg_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(4,1);C.wheel_motor.envelope_intercept_nm*ones(2,1)];
speed=[C.leg_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*ones(4,1);C.wheel_motor.no_load_speed_rpm*ones(2,1)]*2*pi/60;
[~,envelope]=dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(zeros(6,1),s.dq(act),peak,stall,speed);
r=size(J,1);n=6+r;lb=[envelope.lower;-inf(r,1)];ub=[envelope.upper;inf(r,1)];
if any(lb>ub)
 result=struct('status','CONDITIONAL_SIGNED_ENVELOPE_HAS_NO_FEASIBLE_TORQUE_INTERVAL','envelope',envelope,'physical_teacher_valid',false);return;
end
A=[];rhs=[];
for j=1:4
 row=zeros(1,n);row(j)=1/60;offset=s.q(act(j))+2*s.dq(act(j))/60;
 A=[A;row;-row];rhs=[rhs;3-offset;3+offset]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j=[1,3]
 row=zeros(1,n);row(j)=1/60;row(j+1)=-1/60;
 delta=s.q(act(j))-s.q(act(j+1))+2*(s.dq(act(j))-s.dq(act(j+1)))/60;
 A=[A;row;-row];rhs=[rhs;.85-delta;delta+1.0843]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
for j=5:6
 row=zeros(1,n);row(j)=1/.6;A=[A;row;-row];rhs=[rhs;60-s.dq(act(j));60+s.dq(act(j))]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
scale=ones(36,1)/40;scale(1:3)=1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81);scale(4:6)=1/(d.total_mass_kg*9.81*.3);
for j=1:30,if strcmp(C.joints.(names{j}).type,'slide'),scale(6+j)=1/2000;end,end
W=diag(scale.^2);reg=diag([1./peak.^2;1e-12*ones(r,1)]);H=E.'*W*E+1e-9*reg;H=(H+H.')/2;
options=optimoptions('quadprog','Display','off','Algorithm','interior-point-convex','MaxIterations',220,'ConstraintTolerance',1e-8);
[z,objective,flag,solver]=quadprog(H,-E.'*W*b,A,rhs,[],[],lb,ub,[],options);
result=struct('status','CONDITIONAL_REFERENCE_INVERSE_DYNAMICS_NOT_FULL_OWN_PHYSICS','unbounded_minimum_norm_tau6_Nm',least(1:6), ...
 'unbounded_minimum_norm_residual36',E*least-b,'signed_envelope',envelope,'quadprog_exitflag',flag,'quadprog_solver',solver, ...
 'quadprog_objective',objective,'loop_velocity_residual',d.loop_velocity,'loop_acceleration_residual',d.loop_J*acceleration+d.loop_Jdot_velocity, ...
 'qdot_FD_is_reference_condition_not_measured_motor_spin',true,'unknown_spin_and_PD_delay_DR_not_validated',true, ...
 'physical_teacher_valid',false);
if isempty(z)||any(~isfinite(z)),result.status='CONDITIONAL_BOUNDED_INVERSE_DYNAMICS_NO_SOLUTION';return;end
tau=z(1:6);qtarget=s.q(act(1:4))+(tau(1:4)+2*s.dq(act(1:4)))/60;wheelTarget=s.dq(act(5:6))+tau(5:6)/.6;
raw=[qtarget/.5;wheelTarget/10];requested=[60*(qtarget-s.q(act(1:4)))-2*s.dq(act(1:4));.6*(wheelTarget-s.dq(act(5:6)))];
[first,~]=dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(requested,s.dq(act),peak,stall,speed);
[actual,~]=dc_motor_signed_clip_from210_v1(first,s.dq(act),peak,stall,speed);
result.tau6_bounded_Nm=tau;result.selected_loop_reaction=z(7:end);result.residual36=E*z-b;
result.root_force_residual_N=result.residual36(1:3);result.root_moment_residual_Nm=result.residual36(4:6);
result.joint_generalized_residual30=result.residual36(7:36);result.raw6_nominal_PD_required=raw;
result.pd_qtarget4_not_actual_state_clamp=qtarget;result.wheel_velocity_target2=wheelTarget;
result.two_signed_clip_torque6=actual;result.max_bound_or_inequality_violation=max([0;A*z-rhs;lb-z;z-ub]);
result.CAD_and_raw_constraints_included=true;result.two_clip_origin='CAPTURED210_SOURCE_NOT72RUNTIMEEQUIVALENCE';
end

function [low,high,clear]=geometryWorld(f)
low=f.wheel_low;high=f.wheel_high;wheel=[find(strcmp(f.body_names,'left_wheel')),find(strcmp(f.body_names,'right_wheel'))];
keep=~ismember(f.shape_body_index,wheel);overlap=f.shape_high(1,:)>=.35&f.shape_low(1,:)<=1.15&f.shape_high(2,:)>=-.6&f.shape_low(2,:)<=.6;
clear=min(f.shape_low(3,keep)-.27*double(overlap(keep)));
end

function omega=rotationFD(R,dt)
N=size(R,3);omega=zeros(N,3);omega(1,:)=rotationLog(R(:,:,2)*R(:,:,1).').'/dt;
omega(end,:)=rotationLog(R(:,:,end)*R(:,:,end-1).').'/dt;
for j=2:N-1,omega(j,:)=rotationLog(R(:,:,j+1)*R(:,:,j-1).').'/ (2*dt);end
end
function v=rotationLog(R)
c=max(-1,min(1,(trace(R)-1)/2));a=acos(c);vee=[R(3,2)-R(2,3);R(1,3)-R(3,1);R(2,1)-R(1,2)];
if a<1e-7
 v=.5*vee;
elseif pi-a<1e-5
 A=(R+R.'+2*eye(3))/4;[~,j]=max(diag(A));axis=A(:,j)/sqrt(max(A(j,j),eps));axis=axis/norm(axis);
 if dot(axis,vee)<0,axis=-axis;end
 v=a*axis;
else
 v=a/(2*sin(a))*vee;
end
end
function y=fd(x,dt)
y=zeros(size(x));y(2:end-1,:)=(x(3:end,:)-x(1:end-2,:))/(2*dt);y(1,:)=(x(2,:)-x(1,:))/dt;y(end,:)=(x(end,:)-x(end-1,:))/dt;
end
function R=quatMatrix(q)
q=q(:)/norm(q);w=q(1);x=q(2);y=q(3);z=q(4);
R=[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y);2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x);2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)];
end
function [v,m]=readJSON(path,expected,key)
[b,m]=readBytes(path,expected,key);v=jsondecode(native2unicode(b(:).','UTF-8'));
end
function [b,m]=readBytes(path,expected,key)
f=fopen(path,'rb');assert(f>=0);cleanup=onCleanup(@()fclose(f)); %#ok<NASGU>
b=fread(f,Inf,'*uint8');s=digest(b);assert(strcmpi(s,expected),['ExactSHA mismatch ',key]);
m=struct('key',key,'path',path,'bytes',numel(b),'sha256',s,'read_count',1);
end
function s=digest(b)
md=java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');md.update(typecast(uint8(b(:)),'int8'));s=lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(),'uint8'),2).',1,[]));
end
function yes=samePath(a,b),yes=strcmpi(strrep(a,'\','/'),strrep(b,'\','/'));end
function a=writeJSON(path,v)
assert(~isfile(path)&&~isfolder(path));f=fopen(path,'wb');assert(f>=0);cleanup=onCleanup(@()fclose(f)); %#ok<NASGU>
b=[unicode2native(jsonencode(v,'PrettyPrint',true),'UTF-8'),uint8(10)];assert(fwrite(f,b,'uint8')==numel(b));
a=struct('path',path,'bytes',numel(b),'sha256',digest(b),'typed_kind','OWN_CONDITIONAL_REFERENCE_NOT_MODEL_RAW_OR_PHYSICAL_TEACHER');
end

% New own145 reduced-model collocation with hard phase-boundary states.

 old=P.selected;A=L.A_discrete100Hz;B=L.B_discrete100Hz(:);K=L.selected.K_torque_per_wheel;

 assert(N==778 && isequal(size(A),[4,4]) && numel(B)==4 && all(abs(diff(times)-dt)<1e-10));

 while right<numel(clear)&&clear(right+1)>=.001,right=right+1;end
 pitchLo=angles(left);pitchHi=angles(right);assert(pitchLo<pitchEq&&pitchEq<pitchHi);
 target=[old.root_x(:)-xOrigin,old.root_vx(:),old.pitch_error(:),old.pitch_rate(:)];

 f=[-2*d.*reshape(target.',[],1);-.10*old.wheel_torque_increment(1:Nu)];
 Du=spdiags([-ones(Nu-1,1),ones(Nu-1,1)],[0,1],Nu-1,Nu);
 H(nx+1:end,nx+1:end)=H(nx+1:end,nx+1:end)+.8*(Du.'*Du);
 E=spalloc(4*(N-1)+10,nv,25*N);rhs=zeros(size(E,1),1);row=0;
 for k=1:N-1
  at=(k-1)*4+(1:4);next=k*4+(1:4);
  E(row+(1:4),next)=eye(4);E(row+(1:4),at)=-A;E(row+(1:4),nx+k)=-B;row=row+4;

 % Numerically rescale variables/rows only. Unscaled equations, bounds,

  report.maximum_collocation_residual4=max(abs(state(2:end,:)-pred),[],1);

function [x,r]=readPinned(p,expected)
f=fopen(p,'rb');assert(f>=0);c=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));b=fread(f,inf,'*uint8');s=SHA(b);assert(strcmp(s,expected),p);x=jsondecode(native2unicode(b.','UTF-8'));r=struct('path',p,'SHA',s,'bytes',numel(b),'read_count',1);
end
function s=SHA(b)
m=java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');m.update(typecast(uint8(b(:)),'int8'));s=lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(m.digest(),'uint8'),2).',1,[]));
end
function writeJSON(p,x)
assert(~isfile(p));b=[unicode2native(jsonencode(x,PrettyPrint=true),'UTF-8'),uint8(10)];f=fopen(p,'wb');assert(f>=0);c=onCleanup(@()fclose(f));assert(fwrite(f,b,'uint8')==numel(b));
end

function [low,high,clear]=worldGeometry(f,p,isRelative)
low=f.wheel_low;high=f.wheel_high;
shapeLow=f.shape_low;shapeHigh=f.shape_high;
if isRelative,low=low+p;high=high+p;shapeLow=shapeLow+p;shapeHigh=shapeHigh+p;end
wheel=[find(strcmp(f.body_names,'left_wheel')),find(strcmp(f.body_names,'right_wheel'))];
keep=~ismember(f.shape_body_index,wheel);
overlap=shapeHigh(1,:)>=.35&shapeLow(1,:)<=1.15&shapeHigh(2,:)>=-.6&shapeLow(2,:)<=.6;
clear=min(shapeLow(3,keep)-.27*double(overlap(keep)));
end
function H=centroidalH(C,G,d)
names=cellstr(string(G.body_names));H=zeros(3,1);
mass=0;moment=zeros(3,1);PC=zeros(3,31);VC=PC;IB=zeros(3,3,31);
for b=1:31
    row=C.bodies.(names{b});m=row.mass_kg;offset=d.body_rotation(:,:,b)*row.com_m(:);
    PC(:,b)=d.body_position(:,b)+offset;
    VC(:,b)=d.body_velocity(:,b)+cross(d.body_angular_velocity(:,b),offset);
    P=quatMatrix(row.principal_axes_wxyz);IB(:,:,b)=d.body_rotation(:,:,b)*P*diag(row.diagonal_inertia_kg_m2)*P.'*d.body_rotation(:,:,b).';
    mass=mass+m;moment=moment+m*VC(:,b);
end
vCOM=moment/mass;
for b=1:31
    m=C.bodies.(names{b}).mass_kg;
    H=H+IB(:,:,b)*d.body_angular_velocity(:,b)+m*cross(PC(:,b)-d.COM,VC(:,b)-vCOM);
end
end
function m=I_mass(C)
names=fieldnames(C.bodies);m=0;for j=1:numel(names),m=m+C.bodies.(names{j}).mass_kg;end
end
function y=fd(x,dt)
y=zeros(size(x));y(2:end-1,:)=(x(3:end,:)-x(1:end-2,:))/(2*dt);y(1,:)=(x(2,:)-x(1,:))/dt;y(end,:)=(x(end,:)-x(end-1,:))/dt;
end
function R=quatMatrix(q)
q=q(:)/norm(q);w=q(1);x=q(2);y=q(3);z=q(4);
R=[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y);2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x);2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)];
end
function [v,m]=readJSON(path,expected,key)
[b,m]=readBytes(path,expected,key);v=jsondecode(native2unicode(b(:).','UTF-8'));
end
function [b,m]=readBytes(path,expected,key)
f=fopen(path,'rb');assert(f>=0);c=onCleanup(@()fclose(f)); %#ok<NASGU>
b=fread(f,Inf,'*uint8');s=digest(b);assert(strcmpi(s,expected),['Exact input SHA mismatch ',key]);
m=struct('key',key,'path',path,'bytes',numel(b),'sha256',s,'read_count',1);
end
function s=digest(b)
md=java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');md.update(typecast(uint8(b(:)),'int8'));
s=lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(),'uint8'),2).',1,[]));
end
function yes=samePath(a,b)
yes=strcmpi(strrep(a,'\','/'),strrep(b,'\','/'));
end
function a=writeJSON(path,v)
assert(~isfile(path)&&~isfolder(path));f=fopen(path,'wb');assert(f>=0);c=onCleanup(@()fclose(f)); %#ok<NASGU>
b=[unicode2native(jsonencode(v,'PrettyPrint',true),'UTF-8'),uint8(10)];assert(fwrite(f,b,'uint8')==numel(b));
a=struct('path',path,'bytes',numel(b),'sha256',digest(b),'typed_kind','OWN_REFERENCE_CANDIDATE_NOT_MODEL_RAW_OR_PHYSICAL_TEACHER');
end

function q=sampleRow(X,age)
age=max(0,min(2000,age));a=floor(age)+1;b=min(2001,a+1);u=age-floor(age);q=(1-u)*X(a,:)+u*X(b,:);
q0=X(a,4:7).';q1=X(b,4:7).';if dot(q0,q1)<0,q1=-q1;end
dotq=max(-1,min(1,dot(q0,q1)/(norm(q0)*norm(q1))));theta=acos(dotq);
if theta<1e-6,quat=(1-u)*q0+u*q1;else,quat=(sin((1-u)*theta)*q0+sin(u*theta)*q1)/sin(theta);end
q(4:7)=(quat/norm(quat)).';
end
function x=quintic(u),u=max(0,min(1,u));x=10*u^3-15*u^4+6*u^5;end
function dependent=dependentCoordinates(C,names,act)
dependent=[];
for j=1:30
 child=C.joints.(names{j}).child;
 if ~ismember(j,act)&&~startsWith(names{j},'guide_roller_')&&~ismember(child,{'left_wheel','right_wheel'}),dependent(end+1)=j;end %#ok<AGROW>
end
assert(numel(dependent)==16);
end
function [q,receipt]=passiveIK(C,G,names,q,act)
dep=dependentCoordinates(C,names,act);initial=q;target=q(act);iterations=0;usedFallback=false;flag=NaN;solver=struct;
for k=1:24
 s=struct('p',zeros(3,1),'R',eye(3),'v',zeros(3,1),'w',zeros(3,1),'q',q,'dq',zeros(30,1));
 d=own_mod4_tree_dynamics_v1(C,G,names,s);phi=d.loop_phi;
 if max(abs(phi))<1e-8,break;end
 step=-pinv(d.loop_J(:,6+dep))*phi;accepted=false;
 for alpha=2.^-(0:14)
  candidate=q;candidate(dep)=q(dep)+alpha*step;
  if ~withinQ(C,names,candidate,act),continue;end
  f=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,candidate);
  if norm(f.constraint_vector)<norm(phi),q=candidate;accepted=true;break;end
 end
 iterations=k;if ~accepted,break;end
end
g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);
if max(abs(g.constraint_vector))>=1e-8
 usedFallback=true;lo=-inf(16,1);hi=inf(16,1);
 for j=1:16,lim=C.joints.(names{dep(j)}).limits_si;if ~isempty(lim),lo(j)=lim(1);hi(j)=lim(2);end,end
 x0=q(dep);assert(all(x0>=lo&x0<=hi),'No passiveq initialclamp.');
 options=optimoptions('fmincon','Display','off','Algorithm','sqp','MaxIterations',120, ...
  'MaxFunctionEvaluations',4000,'FunctionTolerance',1e-14,'OptimalityTolerance',1e-10,'StepTolerance',1e-12);
 [x,~,flag,solver]=fmincon(@(x)IKObjective(C,G,names,q,dep,x),x0,[],[],[],[],lo,hi,[],options);q(dep)=x;
end
g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);checkQ(C,names,q,act);
assert(max(abs(q(act)-target))==0&&g.closure_max_m<=.002&&max(abs(g.mimic_residual))<1e-6,'Retimedpose not closed under original2mm; retain failure.');
receipt=struct('Newton_iterations',iterations,'fallback_used',usedFallback,'fallback_exitflag',flag,'fallback_solver',solver, ...
 'all6_anchor_m',vecnorm(g.closure_residual),'mimic_residual',g.mimic_residual,'max_passive_change',max(abs(q(dep)-initial(dep))), ...
 'original_motor_target_preserved',true,'no_joint_state_clamp',true);
end
function value=IKObjective(C,G,names,q,dep,x)
q(dep)=x;g=own_mod4_fk_teacher_v1(C,G,names,q);value=sum((1000*g.constraint_vector).^2);
end
function yes=withinQ(C,names,q,act)
yes=all(isfinite(q));
for j=1:30
 lim=C.joints.(names{j}).limits_si;if ~isempty(lim)&&~(q(j)>=lim(1)&&q(j)<=lim(2)),yes=false;end
end
lo=[-1.2;-.5;-1.2;-.5];hi=[.9;.5;.9;.5];a=q(act);
yes=yes&&all(a>=lo&a<=hi)&&all(a([1,3])-a([2,4])>=-1.0843)&&all(a([1,3])-a([2,4])<=.85);
end
function checkQ(C,names,q,act),assert(withinQ(C,names,q,act),'All30original/SDK/CAD jointstate domain required; no clamp.');end

function audit=geometryAudit(C,G,names,D,act,changed)
X=D.packed73;phase=D.metadata.phase_id(:);low=zeros(2001,2,3);high=low;clear=zeros(2001,1);floorClear=clear;anchor=clear;mimic=clear;

 keep=~ismember(g.shape_body_index,[find(strcmp(g.body_names,'left_wheel')),find(strcmp(g.body_names,'right_wheel'))]);
 overlap=g.shape_high(1,:)>=.35&g.shape_low(1,:)<=1.15&g.shape_high(2,:)>=-.6&g.shape_low(2,:)<=.6;
 clear(k)=min(g.shape_low(3,keep)-.27*double(overlap(keep)));floorClear(k)=min(g.shape_low(3,keep));anchor(k)=g.closure_max_m;mimic(k)=max(abs(g.mimic_residual));
end
assert(max(anchor)<=.002&&max(mimic)<1e-6,'All2001originalclosure/mimic checks required.');

touch=D.metadata.events_public_age.touchdown+1;recovery=D.metadata.events_public_age.recovery_end+1;

function summary=IDSummary(H)
rows=H.conditional_inverse_dynamics;N=numel(rows);count=0;touches=zeros(1,6);maxTau=zeros(1,6);maxDQ=max(abs(H.qdot_reference_FD_not_packed_mask_truth),[],1);

 maxTau=max(maxTau,abs(row.unbounded_minimum_norm_tau6_Nm(:).'));

 perRow{j}=struct('age',H.air_public_ages(j),'QPflag_not_feasibility',row.quadprog_exitflag, ...
  'unbounded_tau6_Nm',row.unbounded_minimum_norm_tau6_Nm,'bounded_tau6_Nm',tau,'signed_touch6',touch, ...
  'bounded_base_force_N',force(end),'unbounded_base_force_N',unboundedForce(end), ...
  'bounded_base_moment_Nm',moment(end),'unbounded_base_moment_Nm',unboundedMoment(end), ...
  'loop_velocity_max',max(abs(row.loop_velocity_residual)),'loop_acceleration_max',max(abs(row.loop_acceleration_residual)));
end
summary=struct('air_knots',N,'interior_ID_rows',count,'unknown_boundary_rows',N-count,'per_row',{perRow}, ...
 'max_abs_unbounded_tau6_Nm',maxTau,'signed_touch_rows6',touches,'max_abs_reference_dq30',maxDQ, ...

 'interpretation','Saturation_and_FD_kinematic_consistency_are_separate; comparebothunbounded/boundedresiduals, neverQPflagPASS');

function v=maxOrNull(x),if isempty(x),v=[];else,v=max(x);end,end
function w=quaternionOmegaFD(Q,dt)
n=size(Q,1);w=zeros(n,3);
for k=1:n
 a=max(1,k-1);b=min(n,k+1);Ra=quatMatrix(Q(a,:));Rb=quatMatrix(Q(b,:));R=quatMatrix(Q(k,:));A=((Rb-Ra)/((b-a)*dt))*R.';A=(A-A.')/2;w(k,:)=[A(3,2),A(1,3),A(2,1)];
end
end
function y=fd(x,dt),y=zeros(size(x));y(2:end-1,:)=(x(3:end,:)-x(1:end-2,:))/(2*dt);y(1,:)=(x(2,:)-x(1,:))/dt;y(end,:)=(x(end,:)-x(end-1,:))/dt;end
function R=quatMatrix(q)
q=q(:)/norm(q);w=q(1);x=q(2);y=q(3);z=q(4);R=[1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y);2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x);2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)];
end
function [v,m]=readJSON(path,expected,key),[b,m]=readBytes(path,expected,key);v=jsondecode(native2unicode(b(:).','UTF-8'));end
function [b,m]=readBytes(path,expected,key)
f=fopen(path,'rb');assert(f>=0);cleanup=onCleanup(@()fclose(f)); %#ok<NASGU>
b=fread(f,Inf,'*uint8');s=digest(b);assert(strcmpi(s,expected),['Exactsource/inputSHA mismatch ',key]);m=struct('key',key,'path',path,'bytes',numel(b),'sha256',s,'read_count',1);
end
function s=digest(b),md=java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');md.update(typecast(uint8(b(:)),'int8'));s=lower(reshape(dec2hex(typecast(md.digest(),'uint8'),2).',1,[]));end
function yes=samePath(a,b),yes=strcmpi(strrep(a,'\','/'),strrep(b,'\','/'));end
function a=writeJSON(path,v)
assert(~isfile(path)&&~isfolder(path));f=fopen(path,'wb');assert(f>=0);cleanup=onCleanup(@()fclose(f)); %#ok<NASGU>
b=[unicode2native(jsonencode(v,'PrettyPrint',true),'UTF-8'),uint8(10)];assert(fwrite(f,b,'uint8')==numel(b));a=struct('path',path,'bytes',numel(b),'sha256',digest(b),'typed_kind','OWN_UNVALIDATED_MATHEMATICAL_REFERENCE_NOT_MODEL_RAW_OR_SUCCESS');
end

"""Minimal V2 wrapper: ROOT supplies actual native conditioning receipts.
No model load/forward/optimizer/norm/SDK/physics/trajectory-file operations.
"""
from matlab144_tracking_readback_v1 import check as _unchanged_native_check


def check(mdp,pi,critic,bank_state,*,frames,action=None,previous_action=None,
          normalized_pi_goal=None,normalized_critic_goal=None,
          actual_pi_conditioned_goal=None,actual_critic_conditioned_goal=None,
          norm_literal_receipt=None):
    result=_unchanged_native_check(mdp,pi,critic,bank_state,frames=frames,
        action=action,previous_action=previous_action,
        normalized_pi_goal=normalized_pi_goal,normalized_critic_goal=normalized_critic_goal,
        actual_pi_conditioned_goal=actual_pi_conditioned_goal,
        actual_critic_conditioned_goal=actual_critic_conditioned_goal,
        norm_literal_receipt=norm_literal_receipt)
    manifest=mdp.contract_manifest()
    result.update(schema='OWN_MATLAB144_TRACKING_READBACK_V2',
        physical_leg_dq_goal_unknown_not_selected=manifest.get('physical_leg_dq_goal_unknown_not_selected') is True,
        packed_physical_dq_not_used_for_reference_velocity=manifest.get('packed_physical_dq_not_used_for_reference_velocity') is True,
        reference_velocity_source=getattr(mdp,'reference_velocity_source',None),
        mathematical_velocity_unknown_public_ages=list(getattr(mdp,'mathematical_velocity_unknown_public_ages',())),
        independent_LQR_or_teacher_PhysX_success_not_learning_prerequisite=True,
        reference_is_candidate_not_WM_transition_truth=True,
        original_physical_270_acceptance_unchanged=True)
    result['passed']=bool(result['passed'] and result['physical_leg_dq_goal_unknown_not_selected']
                          and result['packed_physical_dq_not_used_for_reference_velocity']
                          and result['reference_velocity_source'])
    return result

"""NEW144 V2 own-MATLAB goal tracking; candidate learning, no physical skill claim.

The packed table is kinematic_not_physically_validated, never WM transition

Original13 Fudan terms are DIAGNOSTICS here, not a simultaneous .5m/s task.

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from native_fudan_step_adapter_candidate_v2 import OwnFudanStepMdp,BoundOwnStepReward
from private_phase_frame_v1 import decode as decode_private_frame

SCHEMA='mod4.own_matlab144.packed73_reference.v1'
LEG_ORDER=('left_crank','left_hip','right_crank','right_hip')


def require(ok,message):
    if not bool(ok):raise ValueError(message)


def smooth_error(x):
    # Linear tails retain a corrective gradient; no clipped exp/tanh plateau.
    return F.smooth_l1_loss(x,torch.zeros_like(x),reduction='none',beta=1.)


class OwnMatlabTrackingReference:
    def __init__(self,document,device='cpu',*,order_scope='unbound'):
        require(document['schema']==SCHEMA,'Typed own144 reference required')
        self.document=document;self.device=torch.device(device);self.order_scope=order_scope
        self.names=tuple(document['joint_names']);self.metadata=document['metadata']
        require(len(self.names)==len(set(self.names))==30,'Named own physical30 required')
        m=self.metadata
        require(not m.get('synthetic_fixture_only',False) or order_scope=='source_CPU_fixture','Synthetic documents stay sourceCPU-only')
        require(m['control_dt_s']==.01 and m['request_age_ticks']==200 and m['request_end_exclusive']==2000 and m['episode_seconds']==20.,'Original100Hz/20s/request window')
        require(m['reference_status']=='kinematic_not_physically_validated' and m['foreign_transitions_for_world_model'] is False and m['foreign_robot_parameters_used'] is False,'No counterfeit teacher/foreign dynamics')
        require(m['old_fudan13_role']=='diagnostic_only_not_selected144','Explicit new144 task selection')
        require(m['original_command_publisher_m_s']==.5 and abs(m['selected_reference_forward_speed_m_s']-1.188654112279258)<1e-12,'Typed historical publisher vs selected reference speed')
        self.ages=torch.tensor(document['ages'],device=self.device,dtype=torch.long)
        self.values=torch.tensor(document['packed73'],device=self.device,dtype=torch.float32)
        self.mask=torch.tensor(document['mask73'],device=self.device,dtype=torch.float32)
        if self.mask.ndim==1:self.mask=self.mask.expand(2001,73).clone()
        require(torch.equal(self.ages,torch.arange(2001,device=self.device)) and self.values.shape==self.mask.shape==(2001,73),'Complete publicage0..2000 table')
        require(torch.isfinite(self.values).all() and ((self.mask==0)|(self.mask==1)).all(),'Finite source values/literal masks')
        require(torch.allclose(self.values[:,3:7].norm(dim=-1),self.values.new_ones(2001),atol=1e-5,rtol=1e-5),'Packed quaternion is wxyz')
        self.leg_ids=[self.names.index(n) for n in LEG_ORDER]
        known_q=set(self.leg_ids)
        require((self.mask[:,43:73]==0).all(),'No physical dq goal aliases process slots')
        require(all(bool((self.mask[:,13+j]==0).all()) for j in range(30) if j not in known_q),'Wheelspin/roller/passive q are not selected targets')
        self.neutral=self.values[0]
        self.joint_scale=torch.tensor(m['joint_position_range_scale30'],device=self.device,dtype=torch.float32)
        require(self.joint_scale.shape==(30,) and (self.joint_scale>0).all(),'Own joint half-range scales')
        self.phase=torch.tensor(m['phase_id'],device=self.device,dtype=torch.long)
        require(self.phase.shape==(2001,),'Reference phase labels required, not physical process flags')
        n_flight=sum(int(x)==7 for x in m['phase_id'])
        n_terminal=sum(int(x)>=8 for x in m['phase_id'])
        require(n_flight>0 and n_terminal>0,'Explicit flight and posttouch reference durations required')
        # At exact geometry an unqualified terminal's complete undiscounted
        # score is <= one reference flight's maximum score. This is a stated
        # duration-normalization rule, not a claim of global policy optimality.
        self.history_deficit_weight=max(1.,n_terminal/n_flight)
        self.parameters=BoundOwnStepReward(**m['bound_own_step_reward'])

    def bind_named_order(self,names,*,scope):
        names=tuple(names)
        require(scope in ('source_CPU_fixture','actual_SDK_readback') and len(names)==30 and set(names)==set(self.names),'Exact source versus actualSDK named binding')
        require(not self.metadata.get('synthetic_fixture_only',False) or scope=='source_CPU_fixture','Never promote synthetic fixture to actualSDK reference')
        perm=[self.names.index(n) for n in names]
        cols=[*range(13),*[13+i for i in perm],*[43+i for i in perm]]
        doc=dict(self.document,joint_names=list(names),packed73=self.values[:,cols].cpu().tolist(),mask73=self.mask[:,cols].cpu().tolist(),neutral_packed73=self.values[0,cols].cpu().tolist())
        mid=self.metadata['joint_position_midpoint30']
        doc['metadata']=dict(self.metadata,joint_position_range_scale30=self.joint_scale[perm].cpu().tolist(),joint_position_midpoint30=[mid[i] for i in perm])
        return OwnMatlabTrackingReference(doc,self.device,order_scope=scope)

    def to(self,device):return OwnMatlabTrackingReference(self.document,device,order_scope=self.order_scope)
    def active(self,frames):return decode_private_frame(frames)['public_age']>=200

    def _index(self,frames):
        row=decode_private_frame(frames)
        # Never clamp a 137billion packed private frame directly to the table.
        return row['public_age'].clamp(0,2000),row

    def query(self,frames):
        idx,row=self._index(frames)
        value=self.values[idx].clone();mask=self.mask[idx].clone()
        valid=(frames>=0)&(row['delay_ticks']<250)&(row['public_age']<=2032)
        mask=mask*valid[...,None].to(mask.dtype)
        beyond=row['public_age']>2000
        value[...,7:13]=torch.where(beyond[...,None],torch.zeros_like(value[...,7:13]),value[...,7:13])
        value[...,43:73]=torch.where(beyond[...,None],torch.zeros_like(value[...,43:73]),value[...,43:73])
        return value,mask

    def phase_at(self,frames):return self.phase[self._index(frames)[0]]
    def future_goal(self,frames,num_frames):
        require(num_frames==10,'Original goal10x146 unchanged')
        goal=[]
        for offset in range(10):
            value,mask=self.query(frames+offset);goal.append(torch.cat((value*mask,mask),-1))
        return inject_goal_cues(torch.cat(goal,-1),frames)


class OwnMatlabTrackingMdp(OwnFudanStepMdp):
    max_step_reward=.20 # inherited conservative return normalization upper
    def __init__(self,provider,contract,geometry,leg_encoder_joint_names=None):
        super().__init__(provider,contract,geometry,leg_encoder_joint_names)
        self._leg_scale=provider.joint_scale[self.leg_indices]
        self._effort=provider.neutral.new_tensor([contract['leg_motor']['peak_torque_nm']]*4+[contract['wheel_motor']['peak_torque_nm']]*2)
        self._stall=provider.neutral.new_tensor([contract['leg_motor']['envelope_intercept_nm']]*4+[contract['wheel_motor']['envelope_intercept_nm']]*2)
        self._speed=provider.neutral.new_tensor([contract['leg_motor']['no_load_speed_rpm']]*4+[contract['wheel_motor']['no_load_speed_rpm']]*2)*torch.pi/30
        self._action_ids=[provider.names.index(n) for n in (*LEG_ORDER,'left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin')]
        values=provider.values
        # FK cache is POSITION ONLY. No packed physicaldq/spin placeholder,
        # rootv or rootomega is interpreted as a known goal derivative.
        reference=(values[:,:3],quat_to_mat(values[:,3:7]),values.new_zeros(2001,3),values.new_zeros(2001,3),values[:,13:43],values.new_zeros(2001,30),values.new_zeros(2001,54))
        with torch.no_grad():
            refg=self.wheel_geometry(reference)
            z=refg['low'][...,2]
            vz=torch.zeros_like(z)
            vz[1:-1]=(z[2:]-z[:-2])/.02
            vz[0]=(z[1]-z[0])/.01
            vz[-1]=(z[-1]-z[-2])/.01
            self._reference_geometry=dict(low=refg['low'],high=refg['high'],centre=refg['centre'],bottom_velocity=vz)
        # Mathematical path derivatives, not measured physical velocity. The
        # original takeoff/impact uncertainty is retained through metadata.
        unknown={0,2000}
        for age in provider.metadata.get('velocity_unknown_boundary_ages',[]):
            require(type(age) is int and 0<=age<=2000,'Typed boundary publicage required')
            unknown.add(age)
        events=provider.metadata.get('events_public_age',{})
        for key in ('COM_ballistic_start','COM_ballistic_end','touchdown'):
            if key in events:
                age=events[key]
                require(type(age) is int and 0<=age<=2000,'Typed event publicage required')
                unknown.update(range(max(0,age-2),min(2000,age+2)+1))
        # Synthetic/source tables may have phase labels but no event sidecar.
        # Mask derivatives across flight/landing boundaries in that case.
        if not events and 'velocity_unknown_boundary_ages' not in provider.metadata:
            phases=provider.metadata['phase_id']
            for age in range(1,2001):
                if (phases[age]==7 and phases[age-1]!=7) or (phases[age]>=8 and phases[age-1]<8):
                    unknown.update(range(max(0,age-2),min(2000,age+2)+1))
        self.mathematical_velocity_unknown_public_ages=tuple(sorted(unknown))
        self._reference_position_velocity_valid=values.new_ones(2001)
        self._reference_position_velocity_valid[list(self.mathematical_velocity_unknown_public_ages)]=0
        self.reference_velocity_source='ownFK wheel-bottom POSITION(publicage) centralFD10ms, boundarymasked, not physicaldq/spin measurement'

    def to(self,device):return OwnMatlabTrackingMdp(self.provider.to(device),self.import_contract,self.authored_geometry,self.leg_encoder_joint_names)

    def _nonwheel_overlap_cost(self,g):
        low,high=self.process_geometry.bounds(g)
        keep=[i for i,(body,_,_) in enumerate(self.process_geometry.rows) if body not in self.process_geometry.wheel_ids]
        low=low[...,keep,:];high=high[...,keep,:]
        # Minimum AABB separation translation, NOT lowZ-minus-platformtop
        # interpreted as penetration depth. A .1mm X overlap must not become
        # a .17m collision merely because its shape is below the top plane.
        dx=torch.minimum(high[...,0]-.35,1.15-low[...,0])
        dy=torch.minimum(high[...,1]+.6,.6-low[...,1])
        dz=torch.minimum(high[...,2],.27-low[...,2])
        platform=F.relu(torch.minimum(dx,torch.minimum(dy,dz))).amax(-1)
        floor=F.relu(-low[...,2]).amax(-1)
        return (platform+floor)/.005

    def _overrequest(self,state,action):
        q,dq=state[4],state[5];ids=self._action_ids
        a=action.clamp(-6,6)
        target=.5*a[...,:4]
        left=torch.minimum(target[...,1]+.85,torch.maximum(target[...,1]-1.0843,target[...,0]))
        right=torch.minimum(target[...,3]+.85,torch.maximum(target[...,3]-1.0843,target[...,2]))
        leg=torch.stack((left,target[...,1],right,target[...,3]),-1)
        requested=torch.cat((60*(leg-q[...,ids[:4]])-2*dq[...,ids[:4]],.6*(10*a[...,4:]-dq[...,ids[4:]])),-1)
        velocity=dq[...,ids]
        vclip=velocity.clamp(-self._speed*(1+self._effort/self._stall),self._speed*(1+self._effort/self._stall))
        hi=torch.minimum(self._stall*(1-vclip/self._speed),self._effort)
        lo=torch.maximum(self._stall*(-1-vclip/self._speed),-self._effort)
        excess=(F.relu(requested-hi)+F.relu(lo-requested))/self._effort
        return smooth_error(excess).mean(-1)+F.relu(action.abs()-6).mean(-1)

    def selected_tracking_terms(self,state,frames,action,previous_action):
        p,R,v,w,q,dq,aux=state
        target,mask=self.provider.query(frames);phase=self.provider.phase_at(frames)
        refR=quat_to_mat(target[...,3:7])
        reference=(target[...,:3],refR,target[...,7:10],target[...,10:13],target[...,13:43],torch.zeros_like(q),torch.zeros_like(aux))
        g=self.wheel_geometry(state)
        idx,_=self.provider._index(frames)
        refg={key:value[idx] for key,value in self._reference_geometry.items()}
        # Ground pre-request is selected reference tracking too: no old.4m
        # recovery reward is mixed into this explicit NEW144 task.
        ground=(phase<=5).to(p.dtype)
        oriented=mask[...,3:7].amin(-1)
        mathematical_velocity_known=self._reference_position_velocity_valid[idx]
        terms=dict(
            root_xy=(smooth_error((p[...,:2]-target[...,:2])/.10)*mask[...,:2]).mean(-1),
            root_vxy=(smooth_error((v[...,:2]-target[...,7:9])/.50)*mask[...,7:9]).mean(-1),
            wheel_xy=smooth_error((g['centre'][...,:2]-refg['centre'][...,:2])/.08).mean((-1,-2)),
            wheel_bottom=smooth_error((g['low'][...,2]-refg['low'][...,2])/.04).mean(-1),
            wheel_upward_velocity=smooth_error((wheel_bottom_velocity2(g,self.wheel_geometry)-refg['bottom_velocity'])/.50).mean(-1)*mathematical_velocity_known,
            leg_q=smooth_error((q[...,self.leg_indices]-reference[4][...,self.leg_indices])/(.15*self._leg_scale)).mean(-1),
            # Every physicaldq goalmask is0; do not silently select it.
            leg_dq=torch.zeros_like(p[...,0]),
            ground_orientation=smooth_error((R-refR)/.20).mean((-1,-2))*oriented,
            ground_root_height=smooth_error((p[...,2]-target[...,2])/.05)*ground,
            nonwheel_clearance=self._nonwheel_overlap_cost(g),
            closure_excess=F.relu(self.closure_error(g)/.002-1),
            nominal_overrequest=.05*self._overrequest(state,action),
            action_rate=.02*smooth_error(action-previous_action).mean(-1))
        process=process_unpack(frames)
        qualified_landing=process['qualified']&process['crossed2'].all(-1)&process['landing']
        # Persistent HISTORY DEFICIT prevents a long terminal table hold from
        # granting the same maximum return to standing/climbing with no jump.
        # Dense launch tracking above is never gated by ready/flight history.
        terms['terminal_history_deficit']=((phase>=8)&~qualified_landing).to(p.dtype)*self.provider.history_deficit_weight
        loss=sum(terms.values())
        # Native learner maximizes survival-weighted discounted reward. A
        # negative tracking reward would reward premature death. Keep the
        # negative loss only as a diagnostic; all finite selected rewards
        # are strictly positive, bounded, and monotone in tracking error.
        total=.20/(1+loss)
        return dict(total=total,tracking_loss=loss,selected_terms=terms,
            diagnostic_negative_tracking_return=-.01*loss,
            original_process_qualified_landing=qualified_landing,
            teacher_phase_label_is_not_actual_air_or_success=True,
            selected_target='own_MATLAB144_reference_not_historical_command0p5',
            nominal_overrequest_is_not_measured_or_final_effort=True,
            physical_leg_dq_goal_unknown_not_selected=True,
            wheel_velocity_target_is_position_derived_mathematical_goal=True)

    def objective_terms(self,state,frames,action,previous_action):
        selected=self.selected_tracking_terms(state,frames,action,previous_action)
        # Same inherited diagnostic formulas and real/predicted-history scope;
        # their old command/recovery reward is NOT summed into selected total.
        with torch.no_grad():selected['fudan13_diagnostic_only']=super().objective_terms(state,frames,action,previous_action)
        return selected

    def reward(self,state,frames,action,previous_action):
        result=self.objective_terms(state,frames,action,previous_action)
        if torch.is_inference_mode_enabled():self.last_reward_components=result
        return result['total']

    def contract_manifest(self):

# ZJU WBR and SPR online-control reference findings

The user supplied the ZJU WBR repository and a screenshot of the companion online-control section. The official author post separates offline model/controller generation from online detection/state machines. The inspected GitHub commit83414c0be55632b7aa1d4dc9feaa0f5f63d5d93e contains model/LQR/leg-swing acceleration feedforward. The online jump/air/stair controller described in the post is not established merely by running balance.slx.

Eight fixed-commit controller/model/readme source files were fetched through the GitHub connector as text only. function/lqr_numeric.m builds a ten-state/four-input model with wheel and leg/body angle dynamics and static feedforward. ffd/ffd_sim.m follows command shaping, acceleration feedforward, leg-angle limits, position authority and LQR. Its comments declare a reduced state-space plant and a commanded-leg-length approximation; it is not a MOD4 contact-aware jump simulator. Its mass/inertia/geometry/1ms timing/gains have NOT been adopted. This suggests using own MOD4 leg-swing/body-pitch coordination rather than holding all four leg motors fixed and relying on wheel torque alone. That is a design inference, not a proof of the unique cause of159.

A NEW necessary source-only purpose inspected the previously unread SPR chassis.zip inside the supplied outer archive. OriginalV1 decoder LookupError is retained, including one outer nested read and one unpublished source read. NEWV2 corrected only the codec in a new namespace, indexed all nested members and read111project source files/1,320,672B. No firmware/MATLAB/Simulink code was executed. The nested122,201,554B input is represented by its real archive path/member and producer hash, not a copied binary in Git.

SPR chassis/Task/chassis_task.c:827-895 contains real source stages for squat, extension, air contraction, landing preparation and return-ready. Lines956-973 compute gas-spring compensation and set the compensating terms to zero under JumpFlyFlag; this changes their controller compensation, not the physical spring law. It is worth checking how our required motor torque includes spring work rather than blindly cancelling it. The foreign force/length/time constants are NOT MOD4 targets. chassis_task.h:171 and chassis_task.c:977 describe CLIMB_THE_STAIRS as rubbing the stair and rotating the legs. That branch does not satisfy our genuine-jump requirement.

Use the architecture and equations to recompute own31body/30joint MOD4 controls and constraints; retain original6action/PD/CAD/effort/delay/DR/gas2000cap/2mm/TGS32/4/20s. The reference must still execute a real continuous-flight dual-wheel270mm crossing, full-footprint top contact and original12/200stable callbacks. No foreign state sequence or successful-looking picture is physical validation.

#include "bsp_imu.h"
#include "main.h"

extern UART_HandleTypeDef huart7;
extern DMA_HandleTypeDef hdma_uart7_rx;


void UART7_DMA_init(uint8_t *rx1_buf, uint8_t *rx2_buf, uint16_t dma_buf_num)
{
	huart7.ReceptionType=HAL_UART_RECEPTION_TOIDLE;
	huart7.RxXferSize=dma_buf_num*2;
	
    //enable the DMA transfer for the receiver request
    //使能DMA串口接收
    SET_BIT(huart7.Instance->CR3, USART_CR3_DMAR);
    //enalbe idle interrupt
    //使能空闲中断
    __HAL_UART_ENABLE_IT(&huart7, UART_IT_IDLE);
    //disable DMA
    //失效DMA
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart7_rx);
    while(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef  *)hdma_uart7_rx.Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_EN)
    {
        __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart7_rx);
    }
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart7_rx.Instance)->PAR = (uint32_t) &huart7.Instance->RDR;
    //memory buffer 1
    //内存缓冲区1
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart7_rx.Instance)->M0AR = (uint32_t)(rx1_buf);
    //memory buffer 2
    //内存缓冲区2
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart7_rx.Instance)->M1AR = (uint32_t)(rx2_buf);
    //data length
    //数据长度
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart7_rx.Instance)->NDTR = dma_buf_num;
    //enable double memory buffer
    //使能双缓冲区
    SET_BIT(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart7_rx.Instance)->CR, DMA_SxCR_DBM);
    //enable DMA
    //使能DMA
    __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_uart7_rx);

}

#include "bsp_delay.h"

static uint8_t fac_us = 0;
static uint32_t fac_ms = 0;

void delay_init(void)
{
    fac_us = SystemCoreClock / 1000000;
    fac_ms = SystemCoreClock / 1000;

}

void delay_us(uint16_t nus)
{
    volatile uint32_t ticks = 0;
    volatile uint32_t told = 0;
    volatile uint32_t tnow = 0;
    volatile uint32_t tcnt = 0;
    volatile uint32_t reload = 0;
    reload = SysTick->LOAD;
    ticks = nus * fac_us;
    told = SysTick->VAL;
    while (1)
    {
        tnow = SysTick->VAL;
        if (tnow != told)
        {
            if (tnow < told)
            {
                tcnt += told - tnow;
            }
            else
            {
                tcnt += reload - tnow + told;
            }
            told = tnow;
            if (tcnt >= ticks)
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

void delay_ms(uint16_t nms)
{
    uint32_t ticks = 0;
    uint32_t told = 0;
    uint32_t tnow = 0;
    uint32_t tcnt = 0;
    uint32_t reload = 0;
    reload = SysTick->LOAD;
    ticks = nms * fac_ms;
    told = SysTick->VAL;
    while (1)
    {
        tnow = SysTick->VAL;
        if (tnow != told)
        {
            if (tnow < told)
            {
                tcnt += told - tnow;
            }
            else
            {
                tcnt += reload - tnow + told;
            }
            told = tnow;
            if (tcnt >= ticks)
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

//判断遥控器数据是否出错，
bool_t RC_data_is_error(void)
{
    //使用了go to语句 方便出错统一处理遥控器变量数据归零
    if (RC_abs(rc_ctrl.rc.ch[0]) > RC_CHANNAL_ERROR_VALUE)
    {
        goto error;
    }
    if (RC_abs(rc_ctrl.rc.ch[1]) > RC_CHANNAL_ERROR_VALUE)
    {
        goto error;
    }
    if (RC_abs(rc_ctrl.rc.ch[2]) > RC_CHANNAL_ERROR_VALUE)
    {
        goto error;
    }
    if (RC_abs(rc_ctrl.rc.ch[3]) > RC_CHANNAL_ERROR_VALUE)
    {
        goto error;
    }
    if (rc_ctrl.rc.s[0] == 0)
    {
        goto error;
    }
    if (rc_ctrl.rc.s[1] == 0)
    {
        goto error;
    }
    return 0;

error:
    rc_ctrl.rc.ch[0] = 0;
    rc_ctrl.rc.ch[1] = 0;
    rc_ctrl.rc.ch[2] = 0;
    rc_ctrl.rc.ch[3] = 0;
    rc_ctrl.rc.ch[4] = 0;
    rc_ctrl.mouse.x = 0;
    rc_ctrl.mouse.y = 0;
    rc_ctrl.mouse.z = 0;
    rc_ctrl.mouse.press_l = 0;
    rc_ctrl.mouse.press_r = 0;
    rc_ctrl.key = 0;
	rc_ctrl.rc.s[0] = RC_SW_DOWN;
    rc_ctrl.rc.s[1] = RC_SW_DOWN;

	return 1;
}

//串口中断
void My_UART5_IRQHandler(void)
{
        static uint16_t this_time_rx_len = 0;
        if ((((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)huart5.hdmarx->Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_CT) == RESET)
        {
            /* Current memory buffer used is Memory 0 */

            // disable DMA
            //失效DMA
            __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);

            // get receive data length, length = set_data_length - remain_length
            //获取接收数据长度,长度 = 设定长度 - 剩余长度
            this_time_rx_len = SBUS_RX_BUF_NUM - ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->NDTR;

            // reset set_data_lenght
            //重新设定数据长度
            ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->NDTR = SBUS_RX_BUF_NUM;

            // set memory buffer 1
            //设定缓冲区1
            ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->CR |= DMA_SxCR_CT;

            // enable DMA
            //使能DMA
            __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);

            if (this_time_rx_len == RC_FRAME_LENGTH)
            {
                sbus_to_rc(sbus_rx_buf[0], &rc_ctrl);
                //记录数据接收时间
                detect_hook(DBUS_TOE);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* Current memory buffer used is Memory 1 */
            // disable DMA
            //失效DMA
            __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);

            // get receive data length, length = set_data_length - remain_length
            //获取接收数据长度,长度 = 设定长度 - 剩余长度
            this_time_rx_len = SBUS_RX_BUF_NUM - ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->NDTR;

            // reset set_data_lenght
            //重新设定数据长度
            ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->NDTR = SBUS_RX_BUF_NUM;

            // set memory buffer 0
            //设定缓冲区0
            ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->CR &= ~(DMA_SxCR_CT);

            // enable DMA
            //使能DMA
            __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);

            if (this_time_rx_len == RC_FRAME_LENGTH)
            {
                //处理遥控器数据
                sbus_to_rc(sbus_rx_buf[1], &rc_ctrl);
                //记录数据接收时间
                detect_hook(DBUS_TOE);
            }
        }
}

//取正函数
static int16_t RC_abs(int16_t value)
{
    if (value > 0)
    {
        return value;
    }
    else
    {
        return -value;
    }
}

/**
 * @brief          遥控器协议解析
 * @param[in]      sbus_buf: 原生数据指针
 * @param[out]     rc_ctrl: 遥控器数据指
 * @retval         none
 */

#define rc_deadband_limit(input, output, dealine)        \
    {                                                    \
        if ((input) > (dealine) || (input) < -(dealine)) \
        {                                                \
            (output) = (input);                          \
        }                                                \
        else                                             \
        {                                                \
            (output) = 0;                                \
        }                                                \
    }

//这是后面双板通信后，不得不单板时插dr16用该函数使得不用双板
static void sbus_to_rc(volatile const uint8_t *sbus_buf, RC_ctrl_t *rc_ctrl)
{
    if (sbus_buf == NULL || rc_ctrl == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }

    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[0] = (sbus_buf[0] | (sbus_buf[1] << 8)) & 0x07ff;        //!< Channel 0
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[1] = ((sbus_buf[1] >> 3) | (sbus_buf[2] << 5)) & 0x07ff; //!< Channel 1
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[2] = ((sbus_buf[2] >> 6) | (sbus_buf[3] << 2) |          //!< Channel 2
                         (sbus_buf[4] << 10)) &
                        0x07ff;
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[3] = ((sbus_buf[4] >> 1) | (sbus_buf[5] << 7)) & 0x07ff; //!< Channel 3
    rc_ctrl->rc.s[0] = ((sbus_buf[5] >> 4) & 0x0003);                       //!< Switch left
    rc_ctrl->rc.s[1] = ((sbus_buf[5] >> 4) & 0x000C) >> 2;                  //!< Switch right
    rc_ctrl->mouse.x = sbus_buf[6] | (sbus_buf[7] << 8);                    //!< Mouse X axis
    rc_ctrl->mouse.y = sbus_buf[8] | (sbus_buf[9] << 8);                    //!< Mouse Y axis
    rc_ctrl->mouse.z = sbus_buf[10] | (sbus_buf[11] << 8);                  //!< Mouse Z axis
    rc_ctrl->mouse.press_l = sbus_buf[12];                                  //!< Mouse Left Is Press ?
    rc_ctrl->mouse.press_r = sbus_buf[13];                                  //!< Mouse Right Is Press ?
    rc_ctrl->key = sbus_buf[14] | (sbus_buf[15] << 8);                      //!< KeyBoard value
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[4] = sbus_buf[16] | (sbus_buf[17] << 8);                 // NULL

    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[0] -= RC_CH_VALUE_OFFSET;
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[1] -= RC_CH_VALUE_OFFSET;
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[2] -= RC_CH_VALUE_OFFSET;
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[3] -= RC_CH_VALUE_OFFSET;
    rc_ctrl->rc.ch[4] -= RC_CH_VALUE_OFFSET;
		
		int16_t vx_channel,yaw_channel,L_channel,roll_channel;
		rc_deadband_limit(rc_ctrl->rc.ch[3], vx_channel, RC_DEADBAND);		
		TwoBoardControlGimbal.vx_set=(float)vx_channel/660.0f*5.0f*0.4f;

		rc_deadband_limit(rc_ctrl->rc.ch[0], yaw_channel, RC_DEADBAND);
		TwoBoardControlGimbal.relative_angle_yaw=-yaw_channel/660.0f*5.0f*0.6f;
		
		rc_deadband_limit(rc_ctrl->rc.ch[4], L_channel, RC_DEADBAND);//给channel死区限制，有些遥控器的channel默认值可能不为0
		if(L_channel>400)
		{
		TwoBoardControlGimbal.legL_mode=2;
		}
		else if (L_channel<-400)
		{
		TwoBoardControlGimbal.legL_mode=3;
		}
		else
		{
		TwoBoardControlGimbal.legL_mode=1;
		}
		
		rc_deadband_limit(rc_ctrl->rc.ch[2], roll_channel, RC_DEADBAND);
		TwoBoardControlGimbal.roll_set=(float)roll_channel/660*0.3f;

		TwoBoardControlGimbal.mode=rc_ctrl->rc.s[1];//2

}

/*********************************************************************
*
*       RTT memcpy configuration
*
*       memcpy() is good for large amounts of data,
*       but the overhead is big for small amounts, which are usually stored via RTT.
*       With SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY_USE_BYTELOOP a simple byte loop can be used instead.
*
*       SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY() can be used to replace standard memcpy() in RTT functions.
*       This is may be required with memory access restrictions,
*       such as on Cortex-A devices with MMU.
*/
#ifndef   SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY_USE_BYTELOOP
  #define SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY_USE_BYTELOOP              0 // 0: Use memcpy/SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY, 1: Use a simple byte-loop
#endif
//
// Example definition of SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY to external memcpy with GCC toolchains and Cortex-A targets
//
//#if ((defined __SES_ARM) || (defined __CROSSWORKS_ARM) || (defined __GNUC__)) && (defined (__ARM_ARCH_7A__))
//  #define SEGGER_RTT_MEMCPY(pDest, pSrc, NumBytes)      SEGGER_memcpy((pDest), (pSrc), (NumBytes))
//#endif

//
// Target is not allowed to perform other RTT operations while string still has not been stored completely.
// Otherwise we would probably end up with a mixed string in the buffer.
// If using  RTT from within interrupts, multiple tasks or multi processors, define the SEGGER_RTT_LOCK() and SEGGER_RTT_UNLOCK() function here.
//
// SEGGER_RTT_MAX_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY can be used in the sample lock routines on Cortex-M3/4.
// Make sure to mask all interrupts which can send RTT data, i.e. generate SystemView events, or cause task switches.
// When high-priority interrupts must not be masked while sending RTT data, SEGGER_RTT_MAX_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY needs to be adjusted accordingly.
// (Higher priority = lower priority number)
// Default value for embOS: 128u
// Default configuration in FreeRTOS: configMAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY: ( configLIBRARY_MAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY << (8 - configPRIO_BITS) )
// In case of doubt mask all interrupts: 1 << (8 - BASEPRI_PRIO_BITS) i.e. 1 << 5 when 3 bits are implemented in NVIC
// or define SEGGER_RTT_LOCK() to completely disable interrupts.
//
#ifndef   SEGGER_RTT_MAX_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY
  #define SEGGER_RTT_MAX_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY         (0x20)   // Interrupt priority to lock on SEGGER_RTT_LOCK on Cortex-M3/4 (Default: 0x20)
#endif

*       Rowley CrossStudio and GCC

#if ((defined(__SES_ARM) || defined(__SES_RISCV) || defined(__CROSSWORKS_ARM) || defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)) && !defined (__CC_ARM) && !defined(WIN32))

#include "bsp_spi.h"

extern SPI_HandleTypeDef hspi2;
extern DMA_HandleTypeDef hdma_spi2_rx;
extern DMA_HandleTypeDef hdma_spi2_tx;

void SPI2_DMA_init(uint32_t tx_buf, uint32_t rx_buf, uint16_t num)
{
//    SET_BIT(hspi2.Instance->CR2, SPI_CR2_TXDMAEN);
//    SET_BIT(hspi2.Instance->CR2, SPI_CR2_RXDMAEN);

    __HAL_SPI_ENABLE(&hspi2);
    //disable DMA
    //失效DMA
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_rx);
    
    while(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_rx.Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_EN)
    {
        __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_rx);
    }
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG(&hdma_spi2_rx, DMA_LISR_TCIF2);

    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_rx.Instance)->PAR = (uint32_t) & (hspi2.Instance->RXDR);
    //memory buffer 1
    //内存缓冲区1
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_rx.Instance)->M0AR = (uint32_t)(rx_buf);
    //data length
    //数据长度
    __HAL_DMA_SET_COUNTER(&hdma_spi2_rx, num);

    __HAL_DMA_ENABLE_IT(&hdma_spi2_rx, DMA_IT_TC);


    //disable DMA
    //失效DMA
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_tx);
    while(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_tx.Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_EN)
    {
        __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_tx);
    }
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG(&hdma_spi2_tx, DMA_LISR_TCIF3);
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_tx.Instance)->PAR = (uint32_t) & (hspi2.Instance->TXDR);
    //memory buffer 1
    //内存缓冲区1
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_tx.Instance)->M0AR = (uint32_t)(tx_buf);
    //data length
    //数据长度
    __HAL_DMA_SET_COUNTER(&hdma_spi2_tx, num);
}

void SPI2_DMA_enable(uint32_t tx_buf, uint32_t rx_buf, uint16_t ndtr)
{
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_rx);
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_tx);


    while(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_rx.Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_EN)
    {
        __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_rx);
    }
    while(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_tx.Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_EN)
    {
        __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_spi2_tx);
    }

    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmarx, __HAL_DMA_GET_TC_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmarx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmarx, __HAL_DMA_GET_HT_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmarx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmarx, __HAL_DMA_GET_TE_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmarx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmarx, __HAL_DMA_GET_DME_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmarx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmarx, __HAL_DMA_GET_FE_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmarx));

    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmatx, __HAL_DMA_GET_TC_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmatx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmatx, __HAL_DMA_GET_HT_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmatx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmatx, __HAL_DMA_GET_TE_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmatx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmatx, __HAL_DMA_GET_DME_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmatx));
    __HAL_DMA_CLEAR_FLAG (hspi2.hdmatx, __HAL_DMA_GET_FE_FLAG_INDEX(hspi2.hdmatx));


    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_rx.Instance)->M0AR = rx_buf;
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_spi2_tx.Instance)->M0AR = tx_buf;

    __HAL_DMA_SET_COUNTER(&hdma_spi2_rx, ndtr);
    __HAL_DMA_SET_COUNTER(&hdma_spi2_tx, ndtr);

    __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_spi2_rx);
    __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_spi2_tx);
}

/**
  ****************************(C) COPYRIGHT 2019 DJI****************************
  * @file       detect_task.c/h
  * @brief      检测错误任务， 通过接收数据时间来判断.提供 检测钩子函数,错误存在函数.
  * @note       
  * @history
  *  Version    Date            Author          Modification
  *  V1.0.0     Dec-26-2018     RM              1. done
  *  V1.1.0     Nov-11-2019     RM              1. add oled, gyro accel and mag sensors
  *
  @verbatim
  ==============================================================================
    如果要添加一个新设备
    1.第一步在detect_task.h，添加设备名字在errorList的最后，像
    enum errorList
    {
        ...
        XXX_TOE,    //新设备
        ERROR_LIST_LENGHT,
    };
    2.在detect_init函数,添加offlineTime, onlinetime, priority参数
        uint16_t set_item[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT][3] =
        {
            ...
            {n,n,n}, //XX_TOE
        };
    3.如果有data_is_error_fun ,solve_lost_fun,solve_data_error_fun函数，赋值到函数指针
    4.在XXX_TOE设备数据来的时候, 添加函数detect_hook(XXX_TOE).
  ==============================================================================
  @endverbatim
  ****************************(C) COPYRIGHT 2019 DJI****************************
  */
  
#include "detect_task.h"
#include "cmsis_os.h"

/**
  * @brief          初始化error_list,赋值 offline_time, online_time, priority
  * @param[in]      time:系统时间
  * @retval         none
  */
static void detect_init(uint32_t time);

error_t error_list[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT + 1];


#if INCLUDE_uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark
uint32_t detect_task_stack;
#endif


/**
  * @brief          detect task
  * @param[in]      pvParameters: NULL
  * @retval         none
  */
/**
  * @brief          检测任务
  * @param[in]      pvParameters: NULL
  * @retval         none
  */
void detect_task(void const *pvParameters)
{
    static uint32_t system_time;
    system_time = xTaskGetTickCount();
    //init,初始化
    detect_init(system_time);
    //wait a time.空闲一段时间
    vTaskDelay(DETECT_TASK_INIT_TIME);

    while (1)
    {
        static uint8_t error_num_display = 0;
        system_time = xTaskGetTickCount();

        error_num_display = ERROR_LIST_LENGHT;
        error_list[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT].is_lost = 0;
        error_list[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT].error_exist = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < ERROR_LIST_LENGHT; i++)
        {
            //disable, continue
            //未使能，跳过
            if (error_list[i].enable == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            //judge offline.判断掉线
            if (system_time - error_list[i].new_time > error_list[i].set_offline_time)
            {
                if (error_list[i].error_exist == 0)
                {
                    //record error and time
                    //记录错误以及掉线时间
                    error_list[i].is_lost = 1;
                    error_list[i].error_exist = 1;
                    error_list[i].lost_time = system_time;
                }
                //judge the priority,save the highest priority ,
                //判断错误优先级， 保存优先级最高的错误码
                if (error_list[i].priority > error_list[error_num_display].priority)
                {
                    error_num_display = i;
                }
                

                error_list[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT].is_lost = 1;
                error_list[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT].error_exist = 1;
                //if solve_lost_fun != NULL, run it
                //如果提供解决函数，运行解决函数
                if (error_list[i].solve_lost_fun != NULL)
                {
                    error_list[i].solve_lost_fun();
                }
            }
            else if (system_time - error_list[i].work_time < error_list[i].set_online_time)
            {
                //just online, maybe unstable, only record
                //刚刚上线，可能存在数据不稳定，只记录不丢失，
                error_list[i].is_lost = 0;
                error_list[i].error_exist = 1;
            }
            else
            {
                error_list[i].is_lost = 0;
                //判断是否存在数据错误
                //judge if exist data error
                if (error_list[i].data_is_error != NULL)
                {
                    error_list[i].error_exist = 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    error_list[i].error_exist = 0;
                }
                //calc frequency
                //计算频率
                if (error_list[i].new_time > error_list[i].last_time)
                {
                    error_list[i].frequency = configTICK_RATE_HZ / (fp32)(error_list[i].new_time - error_list[i].last_time);
                }
            }
        }

        vTaskDelay(DETECT_CONTROL_TIME);
#if INCLUDE_uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark
        detect_task_stack = uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark(NULL);
#endif
    }
}

/**
  * @brief          获取设备对应的错误状态
  * @param[in]      toe:设备目录
  * @retval         true(错误) 或者false(没错误)
  */
bool_t toe_is_error(uint8_t toe)
{
    return (error_list[toe].error_exist == 1);
}

/**
  * @brief          记录时间
  * @param[in]      toe:设备目录
  * @retval         none
  */
void detect_hook(uint8_t toe)
{
    error_list[toe].last_time = error_list[toe].new_time;
    error_list[toe].new_time = xTaskGetTickCount();
    
    if (error_list[toe].is_lost)
    {
        error_list[toe].is_lost = 0;
        error_list[toe].work_time = error_list[toe].new_time;
    }
    
    if (error_list[toe].data_is_error_fun != NULL)
    {
        if (error_list[toe].data_is_error_fun())
        {
            error_list[toe].error_exist = 1;
            error_list[toe].data_is_error = 1;

            if (error_list[toe].solve_data_error_fun != NULL)
            {
                error_list[toe].solve_data_error_fun();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            error_list[toe].data_is_error = 0;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        error_list[toe].data_is_error = 0;
    }
}

/**
  * @brief          得到错误列表
  * @param[in]      none
  * @retval         error_list的指针
  */
const error_t *get_error_list_point(void)
{
    return error_list;
}

extern void OLED_com_reset(void);
static void detect_init(uint32_t time)
{
    //设置离线时间，上线稳定工作时间，优先级 offlineTime onlinetime priority
    uint16_t set_item[ERROR_LIST_LENGHT][3] =
        {
		/*
			{30, 40, 15}，30为判断丢失的时间，40为初上电时不稳定的空余时间，15为优先级
			30和40不出问题时，单位应该是ms
		*/
			{500, 400, 15},   //CAN 30, 40, 15 SBUS
            {100, 100, 11},   //motor1
            {100, 100, 10},   //motor2
            {100, 100, 11},   //motor3
            {100, 100, 10},   //motor4
            {100, 100, 11},   //motor5
            {100, 100, 10},   //motor6
            {800, 100, 5},  //referee
//            {10, 10, 7},    //rm imu
//            {100,100,15},   //power limit receive
        };

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < ERROR_LIST_LENGHT; i++)
    {
        error_list[i].set_offline_time = set_item[i][0];
        error_list[i].set_online_time = set_item[i][1];
        error_list[i].priority = set_item[i][2];
        error_list[i].data_is_error_fun = NULL;
        error_list[i].solve_lost_fun = NULL;
        error_list[i].solve_data_error_fun = NULL;

        error_list[i].enable = 1;
        error_list[i].error_exist = 1;
        error_list[i].is_lost = 1;
        error_list[i].data_is_error = 1;
        error_list[i].frequency = 0.0f;
        error_list[i].new_time = time;
        error_list[i].last_time = time;
        error_list[i].lost_time = time;
        error_list[i].work_time = time;
    }

}

/**
  * @brief		串口错误中断回调函数
  * @param[out]	串口句柄  huart
  * @param[in]	none
  * @retval		none	
  * @attention  这里的串口错误回调函数是为了应对：串口接收数据过程中出现错误（比如接口接触不良，波特率异常，有设备
				在传输数据中突然掉线等）时，防止串口在一轮接收结束后，串口空闲中断与DMA均被关闭，而使得两者无法通过在回调函数中的
				HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle_DMA()来重启（这就导致发生错误时，就无法无法接收后续的新数据）所以若发生了错误我们需要在
				HAL_UART_ErrorCallback()中再重新开启接收，不然错误一旦发生，串口就再也不会继续接收数据了。
*/
void HAL_UART_ErrorCallback(UART_HandleTypeDef *huart)
{
	if(huart == &huart2)
	{
		HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle_DMA(&huart2,unitree_usart_buf[0],UNITREE_RX_BUF_NUM);//再次开启对应串口接收数据                                                         
	}
	else if(huart == &huart3)
	{
		HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle_DMA(&huart3,unitree_usart_buf[1],UNITREE_RX_BUF_NUM);//再次开启对应串口接收数据                                                         
	}
}

/**
  * @brief		A1电机通信需要的CRC校验
  * @param[out]	CRC数据
  * @param[in]	数据以及数据长度
  * @retval		none	
*/
static inline  uint32_t crc32_core(uint32_t* ptr, uint32_t len)
{
    uint32_t xbit = 0;
    uint32_t data = 0;
    uint32_t CRC32 = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    const uint32_t dwPolynomial = 0x04c11db7;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
    {
        xbit = ((uint32_t)1 << 31);
        data = ptr[i];
        for (uint32_t bits = 0; bits < 32; bits++)
        {
            if (CRC32 & 0x80000000)
            {
                CRC32 <<= 1;
                CRC32 ^= dwPolynomial;
            }
            else
                CRC32 <<= 1;
            if (data & xbit)
                CRC32 ^= dwPolynomial;

            xbit >>= 1;
        }
    }
    return CRC32;
}

/**
  * @brief		USART2的扭矩发送函数
  * @param[in]	扭矩和ID
  * @retval		none	
*/
void USART2_cmd_current(int16_t Motor_T,uint8_t ID)
{
	A1_Send_2.start_1=0xFE;
	A1_Send_2.start_2=0xEE;
	A1_Send_2.Motor_ID=ID;
	A1_Send_2.Reserved_1=0;
	
	A1_Send_2.mode=10;
	A1_Send_2.ModifyBit=0xFF;
	A1_Send_2.ReadBit=0;
	A1_Send_2.Reserved_2=0;
	A1_Send_2.Modify=0;
	A1_Send_2.Motor_T=Motor_T;//单位：Nm,|T|<128
	A1_Send_2.Motor_W=0;//单位：rad/s,|W|<256
	A1_Send_2.Motor_P=0;
	A1_Send_2.Motor_P_K=0;
	A1_Send_2.Motor_W_K=0;
	A1_Send_2.LowHzMotorCmdIndex=0;
	A1_Send_2.LowHzMotorCmdByte=0;
	A1_Send_2.Reserved_3=0;
	
	A1_Send_2.CRC_Data=crc32_core((uint32_t*)(&(A1_Send_2)),7);

	HAL_UART_Transmit_DMA( &huart2, (uint8_t*)&A1_Send_2, UNITREE_SEND_FRAME_LENGTH);

}

#include "bsp_rc.h"
#include "main.h"

extern UART_HandleTypeDef huart5;
extern DMA_HandleTypeDef hdma_uart5_rx;

void RC_Init(uint8_t *rx1_buf, uint8_t *rx2_buf, uint16_t dma_buf_num)
{
	huart5.ReceptionType=HAL_UART_RECEPTION_TOIDLE;
	huart5.RxXferSize=dma_buf_num*2;
	
    //enable the DMA transfer for the receiver request
    //使能DMA串口接收
    SET_BIT(huart5.Instance->CR3, USART_CR3_DMAR);
    //enalbe idle interrupt
    //使能空闲中断
    __HAL_UART_ENABLE_IT(&huart5, UART_IT_IDLE);
    //disable DMA
    //失效DMA
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);
    while(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef  *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->CR & DMA_SxCR_EN)
    {
        __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);
    }
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->PAR = (uint32_t) &huart5.Instance->RDR;
    //memory buffer 1
    //内存缓冲区1
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->M0AR = (uint32_t)(rx1_buf);
    //memory buffer 2
    //内存缓冲区2
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->M1AR = (uint32_t)(rx2_buf);
    //data length
    //数据长度
    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->NDTR = dma_buf_num;
    //enable double memory buffer
    //使能双缓冲区
    SET_BIT(((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->CR, DMA_SxCR_DBM);
    //enable DMA
    //使能DMA
    __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);
}
void RC_unable(void)
{
    __HAL_UART_DISABLE(&huart5);
}
void RC_restart(uint16_t dma_buf_num)
{
    __HAL_UART_DISABLE(&huart5);
    __HAL_DMA_DISABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);

    ((DMA_Stream_TypeDef *)hdma_uart5_rx.Instance)->NDTR = dma_buf_num;

    __HAL_DMA_ENABLE(&hdma_uart5_rx);
    __HAL_UART_ENABLE(&huart5);
}
